note: Curated SEC rule changes for the prototype Radar. Dates checked against SEC press releases and law-firm summaries. applies_from is an approximation by filing date; the true trigger is the company's fiscal year end, so every alert needs human confirmation.

updates.title: Pay versus performance disclosure
updates.what_changed: Proxy statements must include a table linking executive compensation actually paid to company financial performance, plus a list of the most important performance measures.
updates.applies: Proxy and information statements covering fiscal years ending on or after 16 December 2022.

updates.title: Recovery of erroneously awarded compensation (clawback)
updates.what_changed: Listed companies must adopt and disclose a policy to recover incentive pay awarded on the basis of misstated financials, and disclose any recovery under Item 402(w).
updates.applies: Exchange listing standards had to take effect no later than 27 November 2023; annual reports after that should reflect the policy.

sources.title: Cooley: SEC adopts long-awaited final clawback rule

updates.title: Insider trading policies and Rule 10b5-1 plans
updates.what_changed: Companies must disclose whether they have insider trading policies (Item 408(b)), report directors' and officers' trading plans quarterly (Item 408(a)), and describe option-grant timing around material news (Item 402(x)).
updates.applies: Phased in after the rule took effect in 2023; confirm the compliance date for the company's filer status in the adopting release.

updates.title: Cybersecurity risk management, strategy and governance
updates.what_changed: Annual reports must describe processes for managing cybersecurity risk and the board's oversight of it; material incidents must be reported on Form 8-K.
updates.applies: Annual reports for fiscal years ending on or after 15 December 2023.
